action.objective: Commit verified Qb7+, the top exact broad-search move with complete immediate-mate safety.
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 exact search ranks Qb7+ best at -108, ahead of Qh7 (-112, upper bound) and Qxf4 (-173, upper bound). Single-candidate verification at full depth confirms complete immediate-mate safety, tactical_refutation not_found, no forced mate, and commit_ready=true. It gives check, forcing the Black king to respond while keeping our king on g1. No better evidence exists among the alternatives, all of which are upper-bounded and unverified.
